mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(d.deduct_days), 0) FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS'

SELECT d.leave_date, d.leave_type, d.deduct_days FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND d.leave_date >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.leave_date <= TO_DATE(#{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
